mechanics.claim: Ruthless Predator resets Renekton's basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: ''Ruthless Predator {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Renekton's''' basic attack timer.

mechanics.claim: Each strike applies on-hit effects and each is a separate cast/damage instance.
mechanics.quote: Each strike applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects and generates {{tip|fury|{{as|Fury}}}}.

mechanics.claim: Each strike of Ruthless Predator counts as a separate cast instance for effects like Electrocute and Eclipse.
mechanics.quote: Each strike of ''Ruthless Predator'' counts as a separate {{tip|cast instance}} for effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}} and {{iis|Eclipse}}

mechanics.claim: Only the first strike is tagged as spell damage and triggers spell-effect items; all strikes deal basic damage.
mechanics.quote: Each strike of ''Ruthless Predator'' deals {{tip|basic damage}}, but the first strike also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}.

mechanics.claim: The first strike can critically strike for bonus physical damage.
mechanics.quote: ''Ruthless Predator's'' first strike can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Renekton|crit_base}}|100|base=100}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack does not trigger against structures.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}}.

mechanics.claim: Ruthless Predator does not cause two/three separate basic attacks; on-attack/windup-triggered effects (e.g. Lethal Tempo, Hail of Blades) only trigger once.
mechanics.quote: ''Ruthless Predator'' does not cause '''Renekton''' to attack twice/thrice. Effects that trigger {{tip|on-attack}} or interact with the attack windup will only trigger once

mechanics.claim: Reign of Anger version destroys damage shields on the target on the first strike (unless the target is a monster).
mechanics.quote: '''Renekton''' instead strikes 3 times, completely destroying damage-mitigating {{tip|shield|shields}} on the target upon the first strike if they are not a {{tip|monster}}

mechanics.claim: Even if the empowered attack is blocked by a spell shield, it still destroys existing damage shields on the target.
mechanics.quote: Even if empowered ''Ruthless Predator'' is blocked by a {{tip|spell shield}}, it will still destroy any existing damage {{tip|shield|shields}} on the target.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack's cast time is estimated at 0.2 seconds.
Cooldown begins after the ability's effect completes.
In the Reign of Anger version, the first two attacks generate fury but the third attack removes any fury gained since the first attack (bug).
mechanics.quote:
The first two attacks of the {{ai|Reign of Anger|Renekton|empowered}} version will generate fury.{{bug}}
** The third attack will remove any fury gained since the first attack.
